description: Directive 27: the ONLY source of DSBC deployment targets. The client build selects one with VITE_DSBC_ENV (committed .env.<mode> files); the backend reads functions/.env.<projectId>; scripts/directive27/preflight.ts checks all three agree. Nothing here is secret: Firebase web configuration is public by design and is protected by Auth, security rules and the backend.
